goal: Prevent deanonymizing users who enable private broadcast when unconfirmed transactions are resubmitted
Stops the wallet from re-adding dropped transactions to the mempool where peers can link them to the node
agreement: Support for stopping unexpected rebroadcast of wallet transactions over private broadcast (andrewtoth)
Objection that mempool resubmission still leaks to peers was resolved by skipping resubmission (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because resubmitting dropped transactions undermines origin privacy for private broadcast users
Peers can request uniquely held mempool transactions and identify the node as the sender

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents wallet resubmissions from causing unintended clearnet exposure
Protects private broadcast users from having unconfirmed or incoming dust transactions leak their identity
